snippet.title: Wish Upon a Llama - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at the colorful world, characters, and gameplay from Wish Upon a Llama in this trailer for the upcoming cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers. As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits! Wish Upon a Llama will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PlayStation 4 (PS4).
